label: Onboarding Programme Builder
description: Creates comprehensive, role-specific onboarding programmes. Structures the first 30/60/90 days with milestones, key meetings, training modules, and success criteria.

guidedInputs.label: Role and function
guidedInputs.description: Describe the role, team, key responsibilities, and what success looks like after 90 days.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., New Compliance Manager joining the AML team. Responsible for overseeing client risk assessment process, managing 3 analysts. Will be client-facing within 60 days. Success at 90 days: independently managing assigned client portfolio, completed mandatory training, built relationships with key internal stakeholders.

guidedInputs.label: Organisation and team context
guidedInputs.description: What does the new hire need to understand about the organisation, culture, and ways of working?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Fast-paced consulting environment. Matrix structure — project teams vary. Direct line manager is rarely in the same office. Culture is collaborative but autonomous — expected to take initiative quickly. Nordic employment norms apply — flat hierarchy, open communication.

guidedInputs.label: Key stakeholders to meet (by role, not name)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Line manager, Head of Compliance, CFO (key internal client), IT/Systems team (system access), HR (onboarding admin), 2-3 peer managers in the team...

guidedInputs.label: Mandatory training or certifications
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., AML e-learning (by day 10), Data protection/GDPR (by day 10), Information security (by day 5), Firm values and code of conduct (by day 3), CAMS certification preferred within 12 months...
